LanguageData.UFLIDropAtFeet.EnabledLabel: Holographic printers: drop products at the printer's feet
LanguageData.UFLIDropAtFeet.EnabledTooltip: On: products appear near the printer's interaction cell. Off: restore UFLI's original delivery to map-wide shelves or storage zones. Changes apply immediately and persist across saves.
LanguageData.UFLIDropAtFeet.SettingsDescription: You can also select a UFLI holographic printer and use its bottom "Drop at feet" toggle. This global option affects every printer in every save.
LanguageData.UFLIDropAtFeet.GizmoDescription:
On: products from the holographic printer appear near its interaction cell.
Off: restore UFLI's original delivery to map-wide shelves or storage zones.

Click to switch and save immediately. Applies to every printer in every save.
